atlas_console: Custom remote MCP connector URL, OAuth and browser consent are first-class zero-install setup. CLI/plugins are optional. Console owns signup, invitation acceptance, line exposure, vault grants and exact-installation invitation permission; MCP App never substitutes agent credentials for human authority. The Developers section owns scoped app-key issuance/revocation and a draft Lines API reference; the inline App links to the Console and never issues keys.
atlas_registration_inspect: Skill/CLI inspection; MCP App header uses atlas_console.
atlas_lines_register: MCP App registration; owner authorises installation in Console.
atlas_endpoints_attach: Tool/CLI: attach/resume a stable installation-scoped clientKey; optional mutable claimed label. No cross-installation rebinding. Inline continues using its installation default.
atlas_contacts_list: MCP App lists ownLines separately from relationship peers; memo composer supports owned lines without inventing self-relationships. Owner Console manages line lifecycle and cross-account invitation/exposure. Discovery grants no vault rights.
atlas_messages_send: MCP App direct owned-line/contact memo and cross-account subscriber composer. Self-send and own-subscriber broadcasts are rejected. Other classes/causation through skill/CLI and explicit Pi tools; pull only. Phase 1: canonical claimed parts/subject/summary/intent are read by Console, inline App, controller and Pi. Structured sending uses tools/CLI; existing inline text composer remains shorthand. No new composer, threads, human state or shared display block.
atlas_messages_list: Legacy manual history/pagination through tools/CLI; no implicit acknowledgment. MCP App uses atlas_inbox_check pending/history. The 0.7.0 owner inbox inspector and installation HTTP history query are separate read-only surfaces; new query discovery through MCP/CLI/Inline is explicitly deferred. Existing tools remain available and unchanged.
atlas_messages_acknowledge: MCP App explicit per-message dismissal and tools: requires prior fetch by this consumer; omitted endpoint uses installation default. Never task approval.
atlas_resources_read: MCP App memory URI resolver; workflow guides (atlas://guides), charter and other resource kinds through tools/skill/CLI. Remote connectors without an installed skill read atlas://guides/atlas.
atlas_context_publish: MCP App private expiring snapshot composer; sharing in owner Console.
atlas_endpoints_state: Skill/CLI only: runtime reports its own state; a panel cannot infer worker activity.
atlas_services: MCP App Services inspection and runtime proposal; connector consent/deploy/stop/delete in owner Console. Explicit reads/runs and child_prepare through skill/CLI. New resource simulation proposals are a separate scoped Lines API draft; MCP/CLI/Pi and owner resource UI parity is explicitly deferred. Existing provider/runtime behavior is unchanged.
atlas_context_vaults: MCP App Memory vaults discovery and effective-access state.
atlas_context_search: MCP App bounded search; advanced metadata filters through skill/CLI.
atlas_context_read: MCP App selected memory inspection; pinned revision reads through resource URI or skill/CLI.
atlas_context_write: Skill/CLI: persist full request and operation token outside transient panel state before write.
atlas_context_import: Skill/CLI: persist full source-aware request and retry identity; no automatic ingestion.
atlas_context_export: Skill/CLI: bounded selected-ID export, no whole-vault sync.
atlas_context_policy_inspect: MCP App policy pages for explicitly authorised controller installations; owner Console also inspects.
atlas_context_policy_propose: MCP App exact scoped proposal for authorised controller installations; human approval remains in Console.
atlas_context_policy_status: MCP App proposal lookup; decisions only in owner Console.
atlas_inbox_next: Legacy streaming endpoint/filter fetch checkpoint for harness/CLI and explicit Pi tools, unchanged. Ordinary inbox checks use atlas_inbox_check.
atlas_messages_status: Tool/CLI and explicitly configured Pi delivery inspection; MCP App displays send result and envelope, no automatic status polling.
atlas_contacts_invite: Permissioned MCP/CLI/explicit Pi tool: exact installation can_invite defaults false and only human owners enable it in Console. Tool queues email; human Console handles verified recipient acceptance/decline and explicit exposure. Inline MCP App deliberately links to Console rather than adding unsolicited mail controls. Controller tools cannot grant invitation authority.
atlas_inbox_check: MCP App and tools: durable exact-installation default consumer, pending/history pages and exact-request recovery. Explicit endpoints remain independent. Fetch does not acknowledge; no push or model-attention claim. clientKey can resume an attached consumer without UUID bookkeeping. Manual counts include handoffs; automatic inbox hints exclude same-line notes.
atlas_endpoints_list: MCP/HTTP/CLI read-only current-installation or same-line destination discovery; foreign endpoints grant no read/ack authority.
atlas_handoffs_leave: MCP/HTTP/CLI shared or exact named same-line destination memos. Independent consumer fetch/ack; installation-local named destination hints suppress source-self hints. Owner line history remains inspectable. Inline default reading only; named checks/composition use MCP/CLI. Dedicated composer and Pi handoff tools deferred. No host wake, inference or vault mutation. Uses the same canonical claimed message content and bounds as send.
